Pelicans.label: Reported attendance
Pelicans.definition: Attendance published for this game. The NBA summary does not establish paid tickets, gate scans, or ticket revenue.
Pelicans.coverage: One reviewed home game; not a season average or a live feed.
Pelicans.transformation: Published attendance transcribed as an integer; no revenue or utilization inferred.

Saints.label: Reported paid attendance
Saints.definition: Paid attendance as reported in the official gamebook. This is an aggregate publication, not a sales ledger, gate-scan count, or revenue measure.
Saints.coverage: One reviewed home game; not a season average or a live feed.
Saints.transformation: Published paid attendance transcribed as an integer; no revenue or utilization inferred.
